name: life-admin
description: Never miss a bill or renewal, see what's safe to spend, and plan a rainy-day pot. Works in any country; everything stays on your computer.
long_description:
Life Admin keeps track of the everyday paperwork of life, and your assistant does the remembering.

- **Dates:** bills, renewals, insurance, vehicle checks, taxes, subscriptions, warranties, passports, birthdays and appointments, with reminders in your own calendar.
- **Money:** import a bank statement to see where your money goes each week, what's due before payday, and how much you could comfortably put aside.
- **A calm home screen:** large text, plain words, and a Print button.
- **Your country:** your own currency, and public holidays for about 200 countries built in (official gov.uk dates for the UK).

**Private:** your information is kept as plain files in a folder on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.

Try asking: *"Add my car insurance: 412 a year, renews 3 March."* or *"What's coming up this month?"* or *"Show me my home screen."*

It helps with budgeting sums on your own figures; it is not financial advice.

folder.title: Where to keep your life admin
folder.description: A folder on this computer for your bills, dates and spending. It's created for you if it doesn't exist. Most people can leave this as it is.

country.title: Which country do you live in?
country.description: Used for your currency, public holidays and how dates are written. Type its name in English, for example United Kingdom, Ireland, United States, Canada or Australia.

region.title: State or region (optional)
region.description: Some holidays differ by region. For example Scotland or Northern Ireland, California, Ontario or New South Wales. Leave blank if you're not sure.

currency.title: Currency (optional)
currency.description: Leave blank to use your country's currency. Or type a three-letter code such as GBP, EUR or USD.
